title: A note on compact Kähler varieties with pseudo-effective tangent sheaf
summary: In this paper, we discuss recent developments and open problems concerning the geometry of compact Kähler varieties whose tangent sheaves are pseudo-effective in a strong sense. As our main result, we prove that, after passing to a finite quasi-étale cover, any compact Kähler variety with quotient singularities and pseudo-effective tangent sheaf admits a flat fibration onto a complex torus, with rationally connected fibers.
